search_window.basis: Since independently verified preceding Food Line Source Watch heartbeat, with limited October 27–28 indexing lookback; older events not treated as new.

coverage_notes: Supplementary high-value Food Line recall only. The primary nationwide production collector remains authoritative; this watch did not approve, publish, post, alter its schedule, or disable any task.

Executed 12 targeted web searches: four for only/sole/last/full-service grocery loss, fire, or closure; four for storm/flood/fire/outage cancellations of emergency food distributions; two for abrupt food pantry/food-bank closures; two for official SNAP/WIC/EBT benefit-access interruptions. Search recency bounded to 2–3 days, with explicit October 27–28, 2026 qualifiers.

All 12 searches returned usable search results; none confirmed a new U.S. qualifying disruption in the interval. Relevant local events may be indexed late; this is not an exhaustive nationwide negative finding.
